raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Las (Spanish, from Latin 'illas') + Vegas (Spanish, plural of 'vega', from Iberian/Romance 'vaika' = fertile plain) + Boulevard (French, from Middle Dutch 'bolwerk' = bulwark/rampart)",
    "reading": "Fertile plains of the rampart; a defended meadowland raised as a bulwark against the flood of the desert.",
    "languages": ["es","fr","nl","la"],
    "source": "Diccionario de la lengua española (RAE); Oxford English Dictionary, 'boulevard'",
    "confidence": 0.9
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Las + Vegas + Boule + vard; 'las' (Fr. = the) + 'vegas' (Fr. = vague, feminine plural) + 'boule' (Fr. = ball) + 'vard' (Fr. = green, from 'vert' with voiced d)",
    "chain": "las + ve + gas; 'las' (Fr. = tired) + 've' (Fr. = 'v' letter) + 'gas' (Fr. = gas) — 'the tired v-gas'",
    "reading": "The vague green ball; a tired letter V that exhales as gas — the breath of the letter of victory, spent.",
    "languages": ["fr","es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Vegas → 'végas' (Fr. = vegas, but also 'végéter' = to vegetate) → 'vague' (Fr. = wave) + 'as' (Fr. = ace) — 'wave-ace'",
    "chain": "Boulevard → 'boule' (Fr. = ball) + 'vard' → 'ver' (Fr. = worm) + 'd' — 'ball-worm'",
    "reading": "A wave-ace that vegetates; the ball-worm of the rampart — a serpent coiled in the fertile plain.",
    "languages": ["fr","es","en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Las Vegas Boulevard → 'Vegas' = 'gaves' (Fr. = rivers, from 'gave' = torrent) + 'Las' = 'sal' (Lat. = salt) + 'Boulevard' = 'bouvre' (old Fr. = ox) + 'lad' (Eng. = youth) — 'sal-gaves-bouvre-lad'",
    "reading": "Salt torrents, an ox, and a lad — the alchemical marriage of fixed salt and flowing water, the ox as sulphur.",
    "languages": ["fr","la","en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L V B → Latin 'Lux Via Bellum' (light, way, war) or 'Lapis Viridis Benedictus' (blessed green stone)",
    "reading": "The green stone of the blessed way — light as a path through war, the philosopher's stone laid as a road.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L = 50 (Roman), V = 5, B = 2 (Greek beta) → 50+5+2 = 57; 5+7 = 12; 1+2 = 3 — the ternary",
    "chain": "L = ladder (Hebrew lamed = ox-goad), V = vessel (vav = hook), B = house (beth) — 'the ox-goad hooks the house'",
    "reading": "The ladder of the ox-goad hooks the house of the vessel; the number 3 — the triad of body, soul, spirit.",
    "languages": ["he","la","grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Las (L=30, A=1, S=19) = 50; Vegas (V=22, E=5, G=7, A=1, S=19) = 54; Boulevard (B=2, O=15, U=21, L=12, E=5, V=22, A=1, R=18, D=4) = 100 — total 204 → 2+0+4 = 6",
    "reading": "Six — the number of the hexad, the seal of Solomon, the union of above and below on the boulevard.",
    "languages": ["en","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Boulevard from Middle Dutch 'bolwerk' → 'bol' (round) + 'werk' (work) — a circular fortification; later French 'boulevard' = a wide tree-lined avenue",
    "reading": "A round work of defence, turned into a promenade — the rampart becomes a path for the idle walker.",
    "languages": ["nl","fr","en"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary, 'boulevard'",
    "confidence": 0.95
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Las + Vegas → 'la' (Fr. = there) + 'svegas' → 'svegliare' (It. = to awaken) — 'la svegli' (It. = the alarm clock)",
    "reading": "The alarm clock of the fertile plain — a call to wake from the dream of the desert.",
    "languages": ["fr","it","es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Vegas → 'vegas' (Lat. = veins, from 'vena') → 'vena' (It. = vein) → 'vain' (Fr. = empty) — 'las' (Fr. = tired) + 'vain' = 'las vain'",
    "reading": "Tired veins of the earth — the watercourses of the vega are dry, the veins of the land are empty.",
    "languages": ["la","it","fr","es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Boulevard → 'boulevard' → 'bouvre' (ox) + 'lad' (youth) → 'bouvre-lad' → 'labour' (Eng.) + 'dev' (Fr. = god, from 'deus') — 'labour of god'",
    "reading": "The labour of God — the ox of the alchemist ploughs the fertile plain, the divine work of creation.",
    "languages": ["fr","en","la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L V B → Hebrew 'Lev' (heart) + 'Vav' (and) + 'Beth' (house) — 'heart and house'",
    "reading": "Heart and house — the boulevard as the axis between the inner heart and the outer dwelling, the sacred centre.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  }
]
